path.aria-label: Unified memory: less copying, finite space
A simplified data-flow illustration; not all Intel Macs have discrete VRAM.
Data may move between two pools
Intel integrated GPUs can share RAM too
Finite capacity, shared with OS and apps
Sharing memory does not turn 8GB into 16GB.
